description: Source code for an Android media playback service, including a LifecycleService implementation (MusicService) and a Binder class (MusicServiceBinder) managing media playback, notifications, and audio focus.

classes.name: MusicService
classes.description: An Android LifecycleService managing media playback, notifications, and media session controls.

classes.name: MusicServiceBinder
classes.description: A Binder class that controls media playback, manages MediaPlayer, notifications, and audio focus.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the binder when the service is created.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands and actions like play, pause, stop, and foreground service management.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder instance for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: startPlaying
methods.description: Starts media playback if audio focus is granted.

methods.name: stopPlaying
methods.description: Stops media playback and releases resources if specified.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Prepares MediaPlayer with an attachment and starts playback.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks media to a specified position based on percentage.
